content.text: Monitor for Fabric Data Warehouse (Preview) (previously Query Activity) is unified monitoring for Fabric Data Warehouse that shows active and historical queries side by side, supports cross-execution performance analysis powered by Query Insights, and lets you cancel long-running queries with one click. For more information, see Monitor T-SQL queries in Fabric Data Warehouse (Preview).
